prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production master keyframe for Hexy's magical pressure struggle in an anime cartoon game, transparent background.
Reference image is character identity and rendering style ONLY, not the arm pose. Draw ONE full-body Hexy, no sheet. Youthful petite pink-haired witch in blue floppy star hat, white sailor blouse with exactly TWO short sleeves, red bow, blue pleated skirt, blue knee socks and dark buckle boots. Detailed polished cel shading and strong clear silhouette, same youthful face and clothing as reference.
NEW SIMPLE POSE, FRONT THREE-QUARTER VIEW FACING RIGHT: feet wide braced, knees bent, head pitched forward with eyes fierce and teeth clenched under enormous pressure; pink hair blows behind her to the left. BOTH HANDS hold ONE dark star wand close to the CENTER OF HER CHEST; hands stacked close together on the SAME handle, wand tilts 45 degrees up-right. Do NOT stretch either arm forward or overhead. Two elbows are well separated at opposite sides of her waist. Anatomical path on screen: screen-left shoulder -> single sleeve -> upper arm DOWN-LEFT -> elbow at left waist -> forearm UP-RIGHT -> lower hand at chest. Screen-right shoulder -> single sleeve -> upper arm DOWN-RIGHT -> elbow at right waist -> forearm UP-LEFT -> upper hand at chest. The arms form an open V/diamond below the hands, with clearly visible negative space between forearms and torso. Neither forearm crosses the other. Both wrists attach to their own hands on the handle. Exactly TWO arms, TWO elbows, TWO wrists, TWO hands. Do not add an extended arm behind or beside the gripping arms. All shoulders, sleeves, elbows and wrists visibly continuous. Hair stays BEHIND the shoulders, no skin-coloured stray shapes. Keep entire hat, hair, wand star, legs and boots visible with generous transparent padding. NO magical aura obscuring anatomy, no motion echoes, no extra limb, no background, no text.
